summary.text: Martin Jack is a Democratic state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 10 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2012 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Jack, who is also known as Marty, previously worked as a consulting software engineer.

paragraphs.text: Martin Jack's career experience includes working as a consulting software engineer with Symantec, Axent Technologies and Digital Equipment Corporation, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists his House tenure as beginning in 2012, and he has represented Hillsborough 10 since the 2022 election.
He has been assigned to the Public Works and Highways Committee in each session Ballotpedia lists from 2013 through 2024.
